{{small|([[Chairperson]])}} | num_employees = 12,000 (2016) | industry = [[Conglomerate (company)|Conglomerate]] | products = {{Bulleted_list|Tractors|Diesel engines|Automobile parts|Tea plantation|Retail stores}} | revenue = {{currency|83|INR}} [[billion]] (2020) | net_income = {{INR|30.44}} billion (2020) | website = {{URL|http://www.amalgamationsgroup.co.in/}} }} The '''Amalgamations Group''', formerly called '''Simpson Group''', is an Indian business conglomerate based in [[Chennai]] which has several business interests in Manufacturing Tractors, Automobile ancillaries, Plantation, Trading and services.{{cite web |title=Tata Sons chairman to get MMA Business Leadership Award |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/tata-sons-chairman-n-chandrasekaran-to-receive-mma-business-leadership-award/articleshow/108027508.cms |website=The Times of India |date=27 February 2024}} The group today has over 47 companies with 50 manufacturing plants.{{cite web |last1=Anand |first1=N. |title=Amalgamations arm Simpsons plans to develop e-power weeders |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/amalgamations-arm-simpsons-plans-to-develop-e-power-weeders/article68053907.ece |website=The Hindu |language=en-IN |date=11 April 2024}}{{cite web |last1=Vijayakumar |first1=Sanjay |title=NCLAT rules in favour of Amalgamations Ltd., rejects appeal filed by minority shareholder |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/nclat-rules-in-favour-of-amalgamations-ltd-rejects-appeal-filed-by-minority-shareholder/article67388575.ece |website=The Hindu |language=en-IN |date=6 October 2023}} ==Businesses== The most notable businesses operated by the group are as follows: *[[Tractors and Farm Equipment Limited]] *[[Amco Batteries]] *Simpsons & Company *Bimetal Bearings *India Pistons *T. Stanes & Co *[[Higginbotham's]] *Addisons Paint ==History== The Amalgamations Group was established by [[S. Anantharamakrishnan]]{{cite news|title=The road to amalgamation|url=http://www.thehindu.com/thehindu/mp/2003/05/21/stories/2003052100120300.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030710145510/http://www.thehindu.com/thehindu/mp/2003/05/21/stories/2003052100120300.htm|url-status=dead|archive-date=10 July 2003|date=21 May 2003|work=[[The Hindu]]|first=S.|last=Muthiah|authorlink=S.Muthiah}} who during the early 1940s was a Director at Simpsons & Co. extract:
The Amalgamations Group, formerly called Simpson Group, is an Indian business conglomerate based in Chennai which has several business interests in Manufacturing Tractors, Automobile ancillaries, Plantation, Trading and services. 
The group today has over 47 companies with 50 manufacturing plants.
